title: Untwisted Gaiotto equivalence
abstract: This is a successive paper of arXiv:1909.11492. We prove an equivalence between the category of finite-dimensional representations of degenerate supergroup $\underline{GL}(M|N)$ and the category of $(GL_M(O) \ltimes U_{M, N}(F), Ï_{M, N})$-equivariant D-modules on $Gr_{N}$. We also prove that we can realize the category of finite-dimensional representations of degenerate supergroup $\underline{GL}(M|N)$ as a category of D-modules on the mirabolic subgroup $Mir_L(F)$ with certain equivariant conditions for any $L$ bigger than $N$ and $M$.
